title: Schema Dependency Intelligence Tool
description: Wires table name → Neo4j USES_DB edges → dependent files/functions → packet_key joins → ACE context → migration/risk report

includeAce.description: Include ACE context packet in response

operation.description: SQL operation type from Neo4j USES_DB edge

risk.description: Risk level: high=writes to critical path, medium=any write, low=reads

ace_context.description: Whether ACE context packet was built

data_flow: Extract: source_ref, operation, line_num from USES_DB edge properties
Join Postgres: SELECT packet_key, feature_id, feature_label, tree_node_id FROM atlas_packets WHERE canonical_source_ref = source_ref
Classify risk: high=writes in auth/security/payment, medium=any write, low=read
Build summary: count by operation type, high_risk_count
Assess migration_risk: high if high_risk_count > 0, medium if writes > 2, else low

mcp_tool.name: atlas-tools:find-schema-dependents
mcp_tool.description: Find all files/functions that depend on a table; returns migration risk and ACE context

flow: 1. User asks: 'What files use the users table?'
5. ACE packages dependents array into context before Gemma4 synthesis
6. Gemma4 generates migration impact report with grounded file references

responsibility_split.neo4j: Stores USES_DB edges (source_ref, operation, line_num) from static analysis
responsibility_split.postgres: Stores canonical packet_key, feature_id, feature_label for each file
responsibility_split.tool: Joins Neo4j + Postgres results, classifies risk, builds summary
responsibility_split.ace: Packages results into context before Gemma4 synthesis

non_blocking_edges: Neo4j unavailable: returns empty dependents array (non-blocking)
Postgres join fails for a source_ref: returns row with packet_key=null (non-blocking)
No USES_DB edges found: returns empty dependents, summary={total:0,...}, migration_risk='low'
production_value: Migration risk assessment for schema changes
Hotspot detection (which files are high-touch on a table)
Impacted files report for deployment planning
Grounded schema-aware retrieval (files that touch this table)
Code audit trail (who accesses critical tables)
